terms.comment: Fossam fodere, dig a trench; Lewis & Short cites Livy 3.26.9 for this combination.

sources: Lewis & Short: fodio
Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.

phrases.latin: fodiēbat ubi nōn erat fodiendum, rigābat quod jam rigātum erat
phrases.english: He dug where there was no digging to be done and watered what was already watered.
